title: Input System: real frame polling and state restoration

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Open the demo in a Unity Editor with the local bridge, uGUI and Input System installed. Build mcp-server first. This replay temporarily enters play mode, preserves existing unsaved scene content, and never saves scenes. Close unrelated test runs before starting.

steps.title: Run the live regression replay
steps.payload: From the repository root run: node scripts/mcp-input-simulation.mjs --fixture frames --project <absolute-demo-path> --json-out <local-report-path>. Inspect the assertions and attach the JSON report. The script owns fixture cleanup and restores the initial play/edit state.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Every assertion passes, including the press edge during gameplay Update, distinct swipe positions/deltas, named-key release, and pause restoration.
The original player loop, input mode, devices, and initial play/edit state are restored.

steps.title: Record Editor version, assertion count and report path

reset.note: The replay restores its temporary player loop/input settings/devices and destroys fixture objects in finally blocks. It exits play mode only if it entered it. No disk fixture or scene save is required.
